# Neuro & Evil Karaoke API — Sharing and embeds

Base URL: https://api.neurokaraoke.com

Lightweight public endpoints used for browser search integration.

### `GET /public/search/suggestions` — Get search suggestions

Auth: none

Returns search suggestions for the query in `q`, in the OpenSearch suggestions format (`[query, [titles], [descriptions], [urls]]`). Used by browser address-bar search.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `q` | query | `string` | no |  |
| `site` | query | `string` | no |  |

Response `200` OK
